about: TD Power Systems Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells AC generators and electric motors in India and internationally. The company offers steam turbine, gas turbine, hydro turbine, gas engine, and diesel engine generators; and induction, traction, and synchronous motors; and hydro, and diesel power plants, as well as geothermal and wind applications.
